live-evaluation-initial.mode: live Jev on bundled synthetic fixtures
live-evaluation-initial.releaseNote: This small retrieval suite is not a downstream Codex A/B quality evaluation. Full runtime and real-model gates remain required.

live-holdout.kind: Initial calibration with opaque IDs; later used for prompt tuning

live-calibration-after.kind: Prompt-only attempt before partial-preview guard; rejected because middle facts were lost

live-calibration-final.kind: Final calibration with deterministic partial-preview retention

live-validation.kind: fresh synthetic validation; same generator, unseen tasks; not downstream quality

notes: All records are synthetic; no user conversations or credentials included.
Calibration suites reuse fixtures and are not independent benchmarks.
Validation uses unseen tasks from the same generator; it is not a representative production sample.
Long partially visible records are retained by code regardless of model score; gold retention is a hybrid-system metric.
Snapshot recall uses an oracle reader selecting the gold record; it is not LLM retrieval performance.
